messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's authz postmortem — digging through logs shows token validation de-synced for a subset of envs, need owners + staggered rollout plan. I propose a three-wave remediation with audit hooks enabled.

Derek: +1. Can we get a short checklist? also call out which services use legacy token lib.

aj: legacy list: session-svc, api-gateway-lite. I'll own gating and can push patches. target wave 1.

sam: audit logging gap: RDS audit exports were disabled for prod/replica-2. I've re-enabled but need to backfill logs to S3 for 24h window.

incident-bot: Runbook created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/AR-4721

maria: ACTION-4721: @aj patch gateway + session-svc (wave1) — due 2026-03-30
maria: ACTION-4722: @derek add audit exporters + backfill (wave1) — due 2026-03-29
maria: ACTION-4723: @nina validate token schema checks across libs (wave2) — due 2026-04-06
maria: ACTION-4724: @kevin schedule secrets rotation for service-accounts touched (wave3) — due 2026-04-13

Derek: For backfill I'll run:
```
aws s3 cp s3://rds-audit-prod/2026-03-22/part-000 s3://rds-audit-backfill/ --recursive
```

aj: noted, starting PRs today, will tag reviewers: @maria @derek

nina: I'll run quick smoke tests across canary envs and report by EOD Friday.

kevin: I'll coordinate secret rotations with infra; plan to use staged rollout to avoid mass restarts. FYI: rotation window 1:00–3:00 UTC.

sam: we saw recurring pattern across March 3-15 where token validation errors spike at region failovers. capturing that as recurring incident pattern in the tracker.

maria: good call — adding to tracker + will schedule weekly 15m triage till resolved. Next sync Thu 10:30 PT.

Derek: filing ticket for tracing instrumentation to catch validation mismatches: ISSUE-8754

maria: closing loop — please update runbook with any checklist tweaks as you go; I'll update postmortem doc with owners/links.

aj: acked :thumbsup:

kevin: thanks, will post rotation schedule in #eng-sre
